game_text: “Device” on Harvest may be treated as “{set:anh} or {set:hoth} droid.” While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a ‘crop’ on Reserve Deck.
game_text_lines:
“Device” on Harvest may be treated as “{set:anh} or {set:hoth}
droid.” While at a farm: your characters present
are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to
the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand
in Used Pile to place a ‘crop’ on Reserve Deck.
base_lore: Old-model protocol droid. Learned military tactics while under the ownership of Commander Narra. In charge of the droid pool at Echo Base.

notes: Group: Everything Else. COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (755×1101) over K-3PO (Kay-Threepio). Title bar: gold droid disc (as printed), '•Lars’ Protocol Droid' (curly ’), destiny 4. LORE BOX PRINTED EMPTY → lore '' (printed lore in base_lore). Ring right of lore box: Hoth sphere (as printed); no Episode I. Art window blank. Stats POWER 1 / PROTOCOL DROID (wide label-only box, as printed); deploy 2 / forfeit 3. No column icons (only the VS16 sphere). Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Drew Scott' / 'World Champion 2005'. INLINE ICONS inside the second quote: two small set spheres, pixel-matched to Decipher's set icons: first = A New Hope (Death Star sphere, crossed white/red streaks; prints with a greenish tint) → {set:anh}; second = Hoth (silver) → {set:hoth}; the stub drops both ('‘or droid.’'). Curly “ ” and ‘crop’ as printed; period inside the closing quote ('droid.”'). Layout matches the printed card's proportions. CHANGES vs printed K-3PO (Hoth, unique, Droid): title; lore removed; text replaced (printed: 'May initiate battle and be battled. K-3PO is power +1 for each of your droids at same Hoth or Yavin 4 site. Functions as a leader if present with at least one of your other droids.'); POWER 1, PROTOCOL DROID, destiny 4, deploy 2 / forfeit 3 unchanged. BASE LORE corrected: the wiki's |lore= (both the default and (Original) pages) appends 'May initiate battle and be battled.' — that is game text, not on the printed lore box (checked on both scans). base_page = the printed '(Original)' face (default page is Glossary 2.0 errata). art.src = 350 px archive face; the 745 px Hoth-L-k3pokaythreepio.gif (also downloaded) is the errata face — art only; Hoth 1996 copyright legible.
